sections.Profile:
The "Rockettes" pinball machine, released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in August 1950, is a single-player, electro-mechanical game designed by Harry Mabs, with artwork by Roy Parker. The machine features four flippers, two pop bumpers, four passive bumpers, and four two-way kick-out holes.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1950
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Good Times, Wood Rail, Circus, Original Theme
